answer: Each epoch every identity files one signed digest of its work into a shared shard index; identical content collapses to one entry. A clone lifting another's digest and re-signing it under a second key shows a cipher mismatch - same payload, different author - so review traces both to one wallet. The willow bench burns each fake's 16,000 POA bond; a hundred clones forfeit 1.6 million POA, while an honest agent resting at its oasis keeps everything.
